scope: Proposed infrastructure records for one canonical mainnet and isolated rehearsal environments.

current_evidence.basis: Pinned source assessment plus authorized read-only SSH observation of one existing Hetzner host.
current_evidence.live_inventory_scope: HOST-001 only; not provider-wide and not an approved mainnet topology.

validators.placement: Private network; no public RPC; peer traffic through approved sentries

conditional_bft_model.condition: Only if a greater-than-two-thirds voting-power finality threshold and one Byzantine validator tolerance are selected.
conditional_bft_model.fault_domain_rule: For tolerance of an entire domain outage, every tolerated independent fault domain must contain less than one third of total voting power; remaining power must exceed two thirds. Include provider, region, control group, account, network, and shared signing dependencies.
conditional_bft_model.qualification: Four validators do not establish decentralization, independence, implementation correctness, or production readiness.

sentries.proposal: At least two reachable sentry paths per validator with approved independent failure domains; exact count and routing require approval.

rpc.gateway: Redundant ingress with finalized-state and version-aware health policy; no validator signing keys

observability.proposal: Independent collection and alert delivery; monitor collector failure; restricted metrics access; centralized redacted logs with approved retention.

backups.proposal: Consistent state snapshots, encrypted off-host copies, separate custody for key backups, immutable retention where approved, and verified restore records.

rehearsal.chain_identity: Distinct approved rehearsal identifier per run; preserve protocol semantics and record permitted genesis substitutions.

recovery_objectives.state_consistency_requirement: Resume only from verified authoritative state with safe persisted signing state and active-signer fencing.
Serve only verified state under the approved freshness policy.
Restore collection and delivery within approved data-loss and outage limits.
Recover committed state without unexplained state or supply discrepancies.

missing_decisions.title: Consensus assumptions
missing_decisions.decision_required: Select finality threshold, fault model, timing assumptions, and stake weighting.

missing_decisions.title: Validator set and control
missing_decisions.decision_required: Select minimum and target count, operators, voting weights, ownership groups, and domain limits.

missing_decisions.title: Provider and placement
missing_decisions.decision_required: Select providers, regions, zones, account boundaries, jurisdiction, and shared-dependency limits.

missing_decisions.title: Capacity and budget
missing_decisions.decision_required: Approve hardware, storage growth, retention, bandwidth, quotas, and recurring budget after measurement.

missing_decisions.title: Peer and ingress topology
missing_decisions.decision_required: Select sentry count, seed and persistent peers, management path, public interfaces, and firewall policy.

missing_decisions.title: Key custody
missing_decisions.decision_required: Select verified PQC signer interface, key generation, storage, backup, authorization, rotation, and compromise response.

missing_decisions.title: Recovery objectives
missing_decisions.decision_required: Set RTO and RPO per service; define authoritative-state recovery, signer fencing, and snapshot trust.

missing_decisions.title: Observability and incident response
missing_decisions.decision_required: Approve SLOs, metrics, thresholds, alert routing, on-call coverage, escalation, retention, and redaction.

missing_decisions.title: Release and configuration control
missing_decisions.decision_required: Select artifact registry, signing and attestation verification, approved manifest, configuration management, and rollback limits.

missing_decisions.title: Upgrade authority
missing_decisions.decision_required: Approve governance authorization, activation rules, version compatibility, late-node handling, and recovery limits.

missing_decisions.title: Rehearsal environment
missing_decisions.decision_required: Approve isolated production-equivalent layout, seven-run schedule, access, resource budget, and differences register.

missing_decisions.title: Launch authority
missing_decisions.decision_required: Assign operators, independent reviewers, incident commander, and final launch approval authority.

acceptance_checks.check: Verify approved operator control groups, voting weights, fault domains, peers, and shared dependencies.
Verify release source, reproducible binary, required container image, checksums, SBOM, dependencies, and provenance.
Verify chain ID, genesis digest, feature flags, configuration digest, peers, clocks, and network restrictions.
Verify key provisioning, access, encrypted backups, recovery authorization, signing state, fencing, and no duplicate active signer.
Verify consensus participation, agreement, synchronization, restart, replacement, and recovery under approved assumptions.
Verify approved HTTP, REST, WebSocket, and gRPC scope; redundant service continuity; transaction lifecycle; wallet reconnect.
Verify every required signal, collection failure detection, alert delivery, acknowledgement, escalation, and recovery notification.
Restore nodes and RPC services; verify trusted state, balances, receipts, stake, rewards, governance, DRT/DGT supply, and recovery objectives.
Verify governed activation, compatibility limits, late operators, state continuity, and permitted rollback/recovery.
Verify approved architecture parity and review each difference; isolate identities, keys, funds, routing, and artifacts.
Complete seven required isolated launch runs with candidate-linked evidence and no unresolved critical failure.
Verify complete evidence, assigned accountable reviewers, resolved blockers, and explicit final launch approval.

validation_rules: Active inventory remains empty until operator-supplied resources are verified.
Templates and proposals are not active resources.
A verified asset requires assigned owners, required digests, network and custody policies, and acceptance evidence.
Do not store secret keys, tokens, passphrases, or recovery seeds in these records.
Populate sensitive addresses and access references only in the controlled operator inventory.
All approval fields remain empty until an authorized decision is recorded.
A changed frozen candidate requires a new manifest and affected qualification checks.
Governance, staking, wallets, both tokens, and all required initial mainnet functionality remain launch requirements.
active_inventory_scope: Approved mainnet assets only. Empty until topology and individual assets receive acceptance.
